fixes.explanation: Elijah, huh? I love the confidence, friend, but that name never shows up in this passage. What the people begin to say is, "Truly this is the Prophet who is to come into the world." (John 6:14). They'd just seen the sign Jesus performed with those loaves and fish. Thinking of a big name makes sense, but this crowd lands on a different title.

Sending a crowd of five thousand home? I wouldn't want that job, friend. I can barely get a few people to leave my bakery when the cookies come out. But John 6:15 doesn't say Jesus sent anyone anywhere. It says He "…withdrew again to a mountain by Himself." Jesus is the one who moves in this verse.
